notes.title: Full Game RELEASE!
notes.notes:
The full version of the game has now finished all reviews and has been published! 
All eight levels have been available now, and the demo version will stop running in the near future.

If you have any questions, comments and suggestions, please discuss them freely. If you find any bugs in the game, please publish them freely. I will deal with them quickly. Thank you!
